title: Consolidate tenant FK shadowing and safe migration path for control-plane joins
creator: Asha Kulkarni
description: Control plane tables currently duplicate tenant identifiers across many wide tables (project_refs, tenant_id, tenant_uuid) with slight variations in type and nullability. This causes large join fanout, inconsistent FK semantics, and heavy index churn when tenants are soft-deleted or renamed. This ticket designs and executes a low-risk, shadowed migration to consolidate tenant foreign keys into a single canonical reference and remove redundant tenant columns over time.
problem_statement: Multiple tables carry tenant identifiers with different types (text/uuid/biginteger) and duplicated FK constraints. Queries frequently join on these columns or use IS NOT NULL filters, creating hot indexes and poor planner choices. Ad-hoc backfills and emergency patches have added conditional logic in query predicates. We need a consistent, compact reference pattern that reduces join width, simplifies indexes, and provides a safe migration path without large downtime.
background: Past migrations (ENG-24601, ENG-28901) partially normalized tenant ids but left shadow columns and online backfills. Observability shows elevated p95 query latency on control-plane read paths for tenant-scoped dashboards and an increase in index bloat after several backfills. The service team has requested a migration that supports smooth rollback, real-time verification, and light write amplification during cutover.
goal: Introduce a canonical tenant_ref (surrogate) and mapping table, route reads to shadow references while backfilling, perform a tapered cutover with canary queries, drop redundant columns, and add compact covering indexes to reduce IO for common join patterns.
migration_plan: Step 1 — Create canonical table: tenant_ref(id BIGSERIAL PRIMARY KEY, tenant_uuid UUID UNIQUE, created_at timestamptz)
Step 2 — Add shadow column: add column tenant_ref_id BIGINT NULL to tables: projects, environments, audit_events, usage_quotas (batch-safe, no default)
Step 3 — Backfill in rolling batches: backfill tenant_ref_id via join on tenant_uuid using windowed jobs limited to 5k rows per transaction and per-table rate limit
Step 4 — Read routing: introduce read-side shadow preference in control-plane query layer (prefers tenant_ref_id when present; fallback to legacy tenant_uuid) behind feature flag
Step 5 — Canary & verify: run comparison checks for 48h on sampled traffic; escalate on mismatch > 0.1%
Step 6 — Swap enforcement: on success, add NOT NULL + FK constraint and small maintenance window to add FK index concurrently
Step 7 — Deprecate legacy columns: schedule column drops in a later maintenance window after 30 days of stable metrics
backfill_strategy: Batch size: 5000 rows per job; target table lock-free updates via primary key range; use background worker with jitter
Idempotency: jobs skip rows with tenant_ref_id already set
Throttling: scale based on replica lag and WLM; disable during peak deploys
Verification pass: run hash comparisons (sha256 of concatenated id columns) before and after per-batch to detect mismatch
index_proposals: projects: CREATE INDEX CONCURRENTLY idx_projects_tenant_ref_id_created_at ON projects (tenant_ref_id, created_at) WHERE deleted_at IS NULL
audit_events: CREATE INDEX CONCURRENTLY idx_audit_tenant_ref_event_ts ON audit_events (tenant_ref_id, event_ts)
environments: CREATE INDEX CONCURRENTLY idx_env_tenant_ref_name ON environments (tenant_ref_id, lower(name))
migration-aid: CREATE INDEX CONCURRENTLY idx_tenant_uuid_to_ref ON tenant_ref (tenant_uuid)
queries_affected: SELECT p.* FROM projects p JOIN tenant_ref t ON p.tenant_ref_id = t.id WHERE t.tenant_uuid = $1
SELECT count(*) FROM audit_events WHERE tenant_ref_id = $1 AND event_ts > now() - interval '7 days'
Legacy path: SELECT * FROM projects WHERE tenant_uuid = $1 -- will continue to be supported during shadow period
acceptance_criteria: Shadow reads enabled and returning identical results to legacy reads for sampled 99.9% of rows over a 48h window
Backfill job completes for projects/environments/audit_events with <0.5% manual corrections required
No increase in p99 write latency > 15% during backfill windows
New compact indexes reduce median read I/O on tenant-scoped dashboards by at least 20% in lab runs
Rollback path validated: feature flag flip restores legacy reads without data loss
testing_plan: Unit tests for query layer preference logic (tenant_ref_id preferred, fallback to tenant_uuid)
Integration test: deploy in staging with production-sized fixture and run full backfill
Chaos test: simulate replica lag and network partition during backfill to validate throttling and job retry
Canary traffic: route 1% of production queries to shadow path and compare results via comparison harness
rollback_plan: If mismatches exceed thresholds or errors surface, flip feature flag to stop reading tenant_ref_id and resume legacy tenant_uuid reads; pause backfill jobs; delete newly created tenant_ref rows if dead-letter auditing shows integrity issues; re-assess and run corrective reconcile job.
